Want any?|sound=Axel 0078c96c_1.ogg}} '''Axel''' is a [[child]] who could be hired as a decorator at the [[Milepost Zero (location)|Milepost Zero]] branch of the [[Blue Ridge Caravan Company]] in [[Appalachia]] {{in|FO76MZ}}. Recruiting Axel cost 125 [[Supplies]]; he also came with his [[Sentry bot (Fallout 76)|sentry bot]] companion [[Gyro]]. The Milepost Zero gameplay was discontinued with the ''[[Burning Springs (update)|Burning Springs]]'' update. As of that update's release, Axel can no longer be recruited and thus does not appear anywhere in-game. ==Background== {{Section|FO76MZ}} ==Interactions with the player character== ===Interactions overview=== {{Interactions FO76 |none = |ghost =yes |quests involved = |events started = }} ===Upgrades=== All upgrades for Milepost Zero characters, including Axel, are handled through dialogue with [[Marley]], specifically the option to give an employee more resources. With Axel, his tiered upgrades give more options for decoration sets. Each theme gives a different look and aesthetic for the Milepost Zero interior, though the changes are purely decorative and have no other effects. * Tier 1 (initial hiring, default): 125 [[Supplies]] to hire Axel * Tier 2: 150 Supplies ** After upgrading to tier 2, the note "[[Surveying report]]" appears on the table near [[Marley]]. * Tier 3: 200 Supplies ** After upgrading to tier 3, purchasing any theme from Axel will unlock a dialogue option in which he gives the player the [[Plan: Axel's snow globe|plan]] for his snow globe. ===Decoration sets=== At Tier 1, two decoration themes are available from Axel: * Blue Ridge (0 Supplies, default) * Military (40 Supplies) Tier 2 and Tier 3 unlock one theme each: * Tier 2: Antiques (40 Supplies) * Tier 3: Cultist (40 Supplies) ==Inventory== {{Inventory |apparel =Child tattered clothes |weapon = |otheritem = |ondeath =empty }} ==Notes== When purchasing a decoration set from Axel, the interior may not have automatically reset like it did when hiring crew members from [[Marley]]. Exiting and re-entering the Milepost Zero interior would implement the changes. ==Appearances== Axel appears only {{in|FO76MZ}}. He was [[Fallout 76 removed content|removed]] from the game with the ''[[Burning Springs (update)|Burning Springs]]'' update. ==Behind the scenes== {{FO76CC}} * In the game's files, Axel has a system set up to offer a daily miscellaneous quest. The quest would have offered one of several rewards at random, including [[Vault-Tec bobblehead (Fallout 76)|bobbleheads]], [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazines]], common or rare [[Fallout 76 junk items|junk items]], [[Fallout 76 consumables|food items]], or the [[Plan: Axel's snow globe|plan]] for his snow globe. However, this quest is not implemented in-game and cannot be accessed in any way through Axel's dialogue, and was later marked in the files as cut content. {{FO76CC|end}} * Until [[Fallout 76 patch 1.7.15.12|patch 1.7.15.12]] (update 55), Axel's snow globe was unobtainable as a result of the aforementioned cut content. With patch 55, the [[Plan: Axel's snow globe|plan]] was made accessible through Axel's tier 3 dialogue. ==Bugs== {{Platforms|pc}} Axel's dialogue would frequently bug on his opening line, and would close out without accessing the player prompts. It could take several tries to access Axel's dialogue tree without the conversation closing. This was reportedly fixed with [[Fallout 76 patch 1.7.15.12|patch 1.7.15.12]] (update 55).{{Verify|patched}} ==Gallery== FO76MZ Milepost Zero Axel and Gyro.jpg|Axel and Gyro FO76MZ Milepost Zero Axel Decorations 01.jpg|Decorations FO76MZ Milepost Zero Axel Decorations 02.jpg|Decorations {{Stub|FO76MZ}} [[Category:Milepost Zero human characters]] [[Category:Blue Ridge Caravan Company characters]] [[Category:Fallout 76 removed characters]] [[ru:Аксель (Milepost Zero)]]
